visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat generic national-brokerage profile pages by OPENING on the firm — story, reviews, closings, and Call|Text|Email|Schedule — then a team teaser to /team and an inquiry door to /contact. Not a three-Card broker directory. Origin is short Quiet below the fold.

competitiveBrief.productLock: firm story + reviews + closings + Call|Text|Email|Schedule + team teaser→/team + inquiry→/contact
competitiveBrief.refuse: AboutFaces three broker Cards as the opener. Poster-sized three-headshot fold. Looking that invents past this checklist.

beats.text: Firm story opens the page: since 2014, Bend office, who you call works your deal. Not a staff-directory fold.
Firm reviews: brokerage Google record as words (V3Proof), with a door to /reviews.
Firm closings: recent Ryan Realty sales as house-row cards (photo, address, ClosePrice, beds/baths/sqft).
Call is the primary conversion on the reach control, carrying live hours.
Text sits on the same reach control as Call, not a seven-row phone book.
Email sits on the same reach control as Call, Text, and Schedule.
Schedule sits on the same reach control as Call, Text, and Email.
Team teaser doors to /team (and /team/[slug]); inquiry doors to /contact. Brokers are not the opener.

note: Researchy 1–8 / SITE-90 Tip Ready for the Looking gate (2026-09-12). Product lock: firm story + reviews + closings + Call|Text|Email|Schedule + team teaser→/team + inquiry→/contact. AboutFaces is NOT the opener. The About page tip may still be catching up; this contract is the one Looking and ci:taste-canon enforce. No V3Instrument. No V3SourceLine on closings or fold proof. Dates render in Pacific through formatDate.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: AboutPage + aboutOrganization + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage JSON-LD. V3Quiet and V3Instrument carry no structured data of their own.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > About. Surface tone (this page opens on the firm story, not a dark Stage). Current page never a link.

requiredComponents.name: AboutFaces
requiredComponents.section: TEAM TEASER only, after the firm fold — doors to /team and /team/[slug]. Call/Text on the row. NOT the page opener. Product lock refuses three broker Cards as the first object. Canonical /images/brokers/*.png.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Once: #about, late — a short origin plus the firm and principal-broker licences as sourced facts, never a KPI Instrument. The second instance (#who, seven contact rows as the fold) was deleted by SITE-48; the reach it carried is the V3Doors reach control.

requiredComponents.name: FirmClosings
requiredComponents.section: FIRM CLOSINGS in the fold: recent Ryan Realty sales as V3Carousel / shadcn carousel (Card slides: photo, address, recorded ClosePrice, beds/baths/sqft, listing door). Researchy beat 3. Child of the page so about/page.tsx never mounts a city-stats Ledger.

requiredComponents.name: V3Answers
requiredComponents.section: Questions plus the inquiry door to /contact (Researchy beat 8). The same ABOUT_FAQ_ITEMS array the FAQPage JSON-LD emits, as native disclosures, with Contact / Value my home / Homes for sale in the left rail. No answer moved behind script.

requiredComponents.name: V3Atlas
requiredComponents.section: The service area as the living map: every town, community, and Bend neighborhood with a recorded boundary as a door, the region's listings as dots, one claim sentence from the same population the homepage hero reads (buildPlaceAtlas, one source). Replaces the city ledger 2026-09-02 (Matt: every page interactive, no scrolling lists).

requiredComponents.name: V3Proof
requiredComponents.section: FIRM REVIEWS in the fold: the newest verified Google reviews AS WORDS, headingLevel 2, a door to /reviews. Same DAL read (getReviews) and the same quote shaping as /reviews. Researchy beat 2. Not a restated score tile.

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS. Rendered OUTSIDE <main> so the footer maps to role=contentinfo.

requiredComponents.name: V3Doors
requiredComponents.section: #reach — Call|Text|Email|Schedule on one control (Researchy beats 4–7). `primary` on Call with V3OnDuty live hours; Text, Email, Schedule as the lighter alternatives. Inquiry that needs a form doors to /contact.

requiredComponents.name: V3OnDuty
requiredComponents.section: The live state on the reach control: our published booking hours against the Pacific clock, from the same crm_company_settings.booking_hours rows /book offers time from. NEVER a reply-time figure — see components/site/v3/V3OnDuty.view.ts and SITE-09.

layoutComponents.name: PublicNav
layoutComponents.note: Resolves to V3Chrome today. The KbNav entry above is the one the gate auto-satisfies.

deferredComponents.name: V3Sheet
deferredComponents.reason: About destinations open on Quiet + Sheet, but the capture forms already live on /contact and /team/[slug]. Adding a Sheet here would be a new capture contract.

deferredComponents.name: V3Stage
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 4 needs owned media and is never allowed over a number. The firm story opens on cream, not a navy Stage.

deferredComponents.name: V3Field
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 2 is live inventory as a spatial surface. It opens Homes. Using it here would compete with /homes-for-sale.

deferredComponents.name: V3Instrument
deferredComponents.reason: Licenses are one sourced Quiet line (firm + PB), not a KPI hero.
